It found: (1) the question again with one word of its own, a NEED for the library, and a decline that went on with the model's own knowledge all brought back as the NEED; (2) Paris (France) offered for Paris, Kentucky, Mercury (planet) through the model's search words, Light for the speed of light; (3) right chains of two related words questioned (fluorine and chlorine reversed: 396 of 4,300 such chains, against 38 on 1.24.17), and in Chat rewritten wrong; (4) a tea wheel's Black and Green, a feelings wheel's Blue painted. Each was mended or narrowed (CHANGELOG 1.24.18). ok_now: its own verdict on the mended build; final_now (rule 1) and questioned_now (rule 3) are replayed by tests/bench_1258.js.
